vocabulary.definition: A piece of equipment made for a particular purpose.
vocabulary.example: My phone is a useful device for studying English.
vocabulary.sentencePromptVi: Viết bằng tiếng Anh: Điện thoại của tôi là một thiết bị hữu ích để học tiếng Anh.
acceptedSentences: My phone is a useful device for studying English.
My phone is a useful device to study English.

vocabulary.definition: Easy to use or suitable for a particular situation.
vocabulary.example: Online lessons are convenient for busy students.

acceptedSentences: Online lessons are convenient for busy students.
Online classes are convenient for busy students.

grammar.rule: Present Simple: chủ ngữ he/she/it thường thêm -s hoặc -es vào động từ.
grammar.example: She uses a tablet every day.

options: She use a tablet every day.
She uses a tablet every day.
She using a tablet every day.
questions.explanation: She là ngôi thứ ba số ít, vì vậy use đổi thành uses.

questions.prompt: Which sentence describes a daily habit?
questions.explanation: He studies dùng Present Simple với chủ ngữ he.

reading.passage: Mina lives far from her school. Each evening, she uses a small tablet to read short English stories. She saves new words in a notebook and reviews them on Saturday. The tablet helps her study, but she turns it off before bedtime so she can sleep well.

questions.prompt: When does Mina review her new words?
questions.evidence: She saves new words in a notebook and reviews them on Saturday.
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nói rõ Mina ôn từ mới vào thứ Bảy.

questions.prompt: Why does Mina turn off her tablet before bedtime?
questions.evidence: She turns it off before bedtime so she can sleep well.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cho biết Mina tắt máy để ngủ ngon.

listening.script: Hello, I'm Leo. I listen to a short English podcast on my way to work. I write down two new words after each episode. On Sunday, I listen again and check what I remember.

questions.prompt: How many new words does Leo write down after each episode?
questions.explanation: Leo says: I write down two new words after each episode.
Leo nói rằng cậu ấy nghe lại vào Chủ nhật.

writing.prompt: Write 40–60 words about one device that helps you learn English. Say what it is, how you use it and why it helps.
writing.modelAnswer: My phone helps me learn English every day. I use it to read short stories and listen to simple podcasts. When I see a new word, I save it in a note and review it later. This device is useful because I can study anywhere, even on the bus.
checklist: Đưa ra lý do hoặc ví dụ
Kiểm tra dấu câu và thì động từ

speaking.prompt: Describe a device you use for learning. What is it, how often do you use it, and why do you like it?
speaking.modelAnswer: I often use my phone to learn English. I listen to short podcasts on the bus and look up new words. I like it because it is easy to carry and lets me practise for a few minutes every day.
